# ApertureScienceScreensaver

A Portal-credits-style terminal screensaver for macOS.

## Install

**Easiest way:** double-click `ApertureScienceScreensaver.saver`. macOS will
show a dialog asking whether to install it for just you or for all users on
this Mac -- pick one, and it's installed.

**Alternative (Terminal):** open Terminal, `cd` into this folder, then run:

```
./install.sh
```

This copies the bundle to `~/Library/Screen Savers` and opens Screen Saver
settings for you.

Either way, afterwards: **System Settings -> Screen Saver**, then select
"ApertureScienceScreensaver" from the list.

This build is signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by
Apple, so it should install without any Gatekeeper warning.

## Uninstall

Delete it from `~/Library/Screen Savers/ApertureScienceScreensaver.saver`
(or `/Library/Screen Savers/...` if you installed it for all users).
